title: RSGL Project Configuration
description: Project settings for RSGL compilation, output, external resources, and evaluation limits.

root.description: Canonical RSGL source root used by VS Code, LSP, and CLI, resolved relative to this configuration file.

outDir.description: Generated resource-pack root used by VS Code, LSP, and CLI, resolved relative to this configuration file. Must not name the assets directory.

emitSourceMap.description: Whether builds emit RSGL source maps.

manifest.description: Whether builds emit the RSGL manifest.

vanillaResourcePackPath.description: Vanilla resource-pack path used after all custom packs, resolved relative to this configuration file; set to null to disable vanilla lookup.

customResourcePackPaths.description: Custom resource-pack paths from highest to lowest priority, resolved relative to this configuration file.

defaultAssetsPath.description: Deprecated fallback alias for vanillaResourcePackPath; ignored when the canonical field is present.

resourcePackRoots.description: Deprecated fallback alias for customResourcePackPaths; ignored when the canonical field is present.

checkExternExistence.description: Whether external declarations check that matched resources exist.

namespace.description: Project default Minecraft namespace. A namespace declaration in an RSGL file overrides this default.

maxEvaluationItems.description: Maximum compile-time evaluation and expansion work items.

maxItemModelDepth.description: Maximum expanded recursive item-model depth, measured in edges from root depth 0.

target.description: Project-wide Java resource-pack target constraint. Specify exactly one of format or mc.

edition.description: Minecraft edition targeted by this project.

format.description: Java resource-pack format as a positive major version or an exact [major, minor] pair.

mc.description: Minecraft Java version resolved to its resource-pack format, for example 1.21.4.

source.description: Resource lookup source: the target pack, custom resource-pack roots, or vanilla Minecraft assets.

kind.description: Resource kind matched by this external declaration.

patterns.description: Resource ID patterns matched by this external declaration.

checkExistence.description: Whether to check that matched resources exist, overriding the project-wide setting.
